keyFeatures: 36-question assessment identifying your primary attachment style (Secure, Anxious, Avoidant, or Fearful-Avoidant)
Explores two dimensions: anxiety about abandonment and avoidance of intimacy
Reveals how childhood bonding patterns continue to influence adult romantic and platonic relationships
Practical insights for moving toward more secure attachment in your relationships
tips: Think about your patterns across multiple relationships, not just your current one — attachment style is a general tendency, not relationship-specific.
Attachment styles are not fixed: awareness of your style is the first step toward developing more secure relating patterns.
